label: Joint venture
definition: A shared vehicle in which the investor and the landowner or council both hold a stake.

label: Development partnership
definition: A landowner or council appoints a partner to deliver the development, often under a development agreement.

label: Capital investment
definition: Equity or debt invested in the development or its delivery vehicle.

label: Forward funding
definition: An investor funds construction in return for the completed asset, such as build-to-rent homes.

label: Land sale
definition: The sale of a freehold or long leasehold to an investor or developer.

label: Occupier
definition: Space for tenants or owner-occupiers, such as offices, workspace, shops or venues.

label: Other
definition: A way to take part that is not listed here. Describe it in opportunity-type-notes.
